decisions.reason: The lettering clause independently affects caption font and is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY; the B-roll change requires no further font-state change.
The candidate already requires a complete full lesson or story; the source reiterates that standard and reports an incomplete submitted clip without changing the requirement value.
Requiring B-roll in each full lesson does not change the existing clean, simple visual-editing rules.
The source does not alter the white-text-only or no-text-effects requirements.
The reference to a 45-second clip identifies a violation of the existing 70-to-85-second rule but does not establish a new duration range.
The B-roll and lesson-completeness instruction does not change music selection or volume requirements.
The source does not change the existing requirement to select substantive lessons, stories, or real points; it concerns B-roll coverage and completion of the selected lesson.
The source adds a per-video B-roll quality rule but does not change the assigned batch count or the obligation to create and submit the batch.
The source does not restrict or change which YouTube source videos may be selected.
The per-video B-roll instruction does not change the deferred monthly quota, approval basis, or rejected-clip treatment.
The source does not change the requirement for client approval before publication.
The source contains no instruction changing clip-hook selection or opening quality.
